rawContent: The deaths of #MikeBrown & #EricGarner (along with the Ferguson uprising & the start of the #BlackLivesMatter movement) happened under Barack Obama, who signed a Blue Lives Matter bill before he left office. Obama also let cops brutalize Indigenous folks at #StandingRock.

Just wanna remind people to ignore concern trolls who say "Defund/abolish the police is bad because the slogan/movement doesn't poll well!"

People made the same kind of criticisms of "#BlackLivesMatter" (the phrase & movement), especially in the early days of the movement. https://t.co/SJrbzgLu06

This was back when Starbucks' CEO Howard Schultz came up with the absurd "Race Together" campaign where he encouraged Starbucks workers to talk about race (as a response to the #BlackLivesMatter movement). So protesters took Starbucks up on that: https://t.co/0mxpsHC0hi
